zh: 修复重绘消息导航在宿主轨标不再写 `data-index` 的宿主上点击无反应的问题：轨标数量与列表一致时按轨道自己的顺序取标记，宿主写下的位置照旧优先。
en: Fix the redrawn message navigator ignoring a press on hosts whose rail marks carry no `data-index`: while the rail holds as many marks as the list has turns, a mark is now taken by its place in the rail, and a place the host states is still read first.
